resources.string: Local Both recordings: audio track 1 is game, track 2 is microphone. Edit both in your video editor; players may play only one. Adds one AAC encoder. Live streams and their archives keep mixed audio. Does not change game voice chat.
Optional two-track local MP4 recordings for editing, with individual AAC bitrates. Off by default. Uses one extra audio encoder; video capture is unchanged.
An audio encoder error no longer deletes a two-track recording, and two-track startup gets a larger pre-muxer audio buffer.
Optional accessibility assistance for game voice chat. No screen access or overlays. Verified on Android 12 / MIUI 14; other devices may still be silenced by Android.

Allows REC to request shared microphone input while a game uses voice chat. Enable only if you want this recording assistance. No screen content, touch actions, accessibility events or overlays are used. Android and the game may still prevent audio capture. Verified on Android 12 / MIUI 14 only; other devices may behave differently.
Enable REC microphone assistance in Accessibility settings
Assistance connected. Sharing still depends on Android and the game.
Assistance disconnected. Normal microphone policy applies.
Android has silenced REC microphone input. Recorded voice is unavailable.
Active status and controls for zero-copy screen recording
Quick recording and overlay controls in notification shade
REC requires overlay permission to show the floating game pill controls.
